svg.title: Custom reports: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#326)
svg.desc: The custom reports epic in three parts: the team’s own fields made filterable and countable (#327, #334); a report builder that asks questions of now, over time and across teams (#328, #329, #332); and what a team keeps and sends on: saved reports, dashboards, export and email (#330, #331, #333).
svg.text: Custom reports: how the pieces fit
· a team’s own questions, its own fields included
